reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
China-region platform: keys are issued by and bound to the China account system and are not interchangeable with the international platform's keys.
Subscription (plan) credential: usage is metered against plan quota, not per-token list prices, so models on this row carry no `pricing`.

Baidu's Coding Plan page (https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/qianfan/s/imlg0beiu) states the plan is for interactive coding tools and NOT for scripts or backend/batch calls; its function-calling list (https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/qianfan-docs/s/xm95lyys5) names none of the plan's models, so every row here is tool-less (fail-closed) until Baidu documents it.
